paid_approvals_evidence_check.name: paid_approvals_evidence_check
paid_approvals_evidence_check.value: "paid_reading_approvals"."sample_count" >= 6 and length("paid_reading_approvals"."reviewer") between 1 and 200 and length("paid_reading_approvals"."evidence") between 1 and 2000 and "paid_reading_approvals"."locale" in ('en','es')

paid_attempts_money_check.name: paid_attempts_money_check
paid_attempts_money_check.value: "paid_reading_attempts"."reserved_micros" between 1 and 10000000 and ("paid_reading_attempts"."cost_micros" is null or "paid_reading_attempts"."cost_micros" between 0 and 9007199254740991)

paid_attempts_settlement_check.name: paid_attempts_settlement_check
paid_attempts_settlement_check.value: ("paid_reading_attempts"."state" = 'reserved' and "paid_reading_attempts"."cost_micros" is null and "paid_reading_attempts"."settled_at" is null) or ("paid_reading_attempts"."state" <> 'reserved' and "paid_reading_attempts"."cost_micros" is not null and "paid_reading_attempts"."settled_at" is not null)

paid_checkpoints_output_check.name: paid_checkpoints_output_check
paid_checkpoints_output_check.value: ("paid_reading_checkpoints"."kind" = 'valid' and "paid_reading_checkpoints"."output" is not null and octet_length("paid_reading_checkpoints"."output"::text) <= 131072) or ("paid_reading_checkpoints"."kind" = 'invalid' and "paid_reading_checkpoints"."output" is null)

paid_runs_state_check.name: paid_runs_state_check
paid_runs_state_check.value: "paid_reading_runs"."completed_sections" between 0 and 9 and "paid_reading_runs"."status" in ('queued','preparing','generating','completed','partial','failed','stopped','attention') and ("paid_reading_runs"."status" not in ('completed','partial') or "paid_reading_runs"."consumed_at" is not null)

reading_attempts_money_check.name: reading_attempts_money_check
reading_attempts_money_check.value: "reading_generation_attempts"."reserved_micros" between 0 and 5000000 and ("reading_generation_attempts"."cost_micros" is null or "reading_generation_attempts"."cost_micros" between 0 and 9007199254740991)

reading_attempts_settlement_check.name: reading_attempts_settlement_check
reading_attempts_settlement_check.value: ("reading_generation_attempts"."state" = 'reserved' and "reading_generation_attempts"."cost_micros" is null and "reading_generation_attempts"."settled_at" is null) or ("reading_generation_attempts"."state" <> 'reserved' and "reading_generation_attempts"."cost_micros" is not null and "reading_generation_attempts"."settled_at" is not null)

reading_consents_grant_check.name: reading_consents_grant_check
reading_consents_grant_check.value: "reading_generation_consents"."granted_at" is null or ("reading_generation_consents"."policy_hash" is not null and "reading_generation_consents"."processor_id" is not null and "reading_generation_consents"."policy_version" is not null)
